comments.text:
Worked retail most of my working life. Including during the entire pandemic, picking drive up orders. Day after day, running 15-20 miles on 2 shot knees and bad back risking my own health and safety every single day to do people's shopping for them so they didn't have to expose themselves.

What's more is, the kids who just had to run bags to cars? BANKED ON TIPS for OUR labor and got to keep it all. At least some were making more off the tips than their actual paychecks.  But I was just being an asshole when I pointed it out, even through accepting tips was supposedly expressly forbidden. 

Always fun being driven like cattle all day! And for our trouble? We got LESS and the company got WAY MORE! Well...that's Target after all! Expect more, pay less is not just a marketing slogan! It's also the motto for the average workers. 

Had people asking me things while I was a sweaty train wreck that could barely breathe much less try to form words from my constantly dehydrated lips and foggy brain as I'm being chased by a timer to gather every item ON TIME or else...and even though I WAS THE BEST, there was no love for me or anyone like me beyond how good we made them look. When it came time to reciprocate? All we got was "FUCK OFF!" 

That's what you should expect from college grads who weren't qualified to get any better jobs and had to slum it taking a job that allowed them to be the same douchebags they were in high school and will actually pay them for it. And they're driving once good retailers STRAIGHT into the ground.
